newsitem.title: USA: Iraqi foreign minister to meet UN official on oil.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi foreign minister to meet UN official on oil.

text.p: Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf is scheduled to meet the head of the U.N. Humanitarian Affairs Department (DHA) Friday morning, and will likely push for increased income from the oil-for-food deal, U.N. officials said Friday.
Earlier Friday, Iraqi oil minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed said U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan was prepared to suggest an increase in the money permitted for oil sales.
"Rasheed will likely repeat what was said earlier in Baghdad," said a U.N. official.
Western diplomats quickly shot down Rasheed's statement, saying no formal request for increased income was seen from Baghdad, and would not be considered at this point.
Al-Sahaf will meet DHA head Asushi Akashi at 1000 EST/1500 GMT in New York, the U.N. official said.
